changelog:
Initial release of full-mail – provides complete email sending and receiving features.

- Supports sending emails via SMTP, including attachments and multiple recipients.
- Supports receiving, listing, searching, reading, downloading attachments, marking as read, and deleting emails via IMAP.
- Configuration guidance and common email provider settings included.
- Step-by-step instructions for obtaining authorization codes for major email services.
- Troubleshooting section for common issues.
summary: 完整邮件功能 - 支持发送 (SMTP) 和接收 (IMAP) 邮件
